podcast.title: Musical Trend (Early 1970s)
podcast.body: "Mellow" was the prevailing term used in the early 1970s to describe a soft music trend. This trend saw many fans abandoning the acid rock, funk, and R&B of the 1960s in favor of artists like James Taylor, Bread, Olivia Newton-John, Paul Simon, The Eagles, and Fleetwood Mac, contributing to a "cancer of Mellow" that irritated certain groups. "The word everyone was using was Mellow, James Taylor, Bread, Olivia Newton John, Paul Simon, the California Rock of the Eagles, a new look Fleetwood Mac."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
